section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single convenience sample of undergraduate women (initial N=143; final N=142 after exclusion). Participants were recruited from an Introductory Psychology class for course credit; ages ranged 17–24 (M=18.68). BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight (mean BMI = 22.22), and 86.9% of respondents who reported ethnicity identified as Caucasian.
